runtimeMapping.ownerHeal: All four mode Heal nodes select at CAST0; Attack OnAttack .433 is independently bound in Front and Back, capped at1 ASPD playback. Speed5 projectile is retained across owner withdrawal; impact rechecks the selected deployment and ordinary HEAL restrictions. Source postFilter64 plus original description bounds priority to injured self/own Mon3tr before other legal injured allies. Own explicit HealFree bypass never permits external noHeal/isolation.
runtimeMapping.token: Original token own phase/level/potential talent records; no parent trust/stat copying. Cost10, slot1, block3, ground placement/facing. Original single Skeleton is aliased in both render directions; normal .233, S2 .367 and S3 .667 original OnAttack, ASPDcap1. Every ability CAST0 reacquires release victims; own source switch increments attack epoch so unborn previous mode releases cancel.
runtimeMapping.defZero: Native kalts_t_1[def_zero] uses DEF FINAL_SCALER0. Owner range marker membership applies/removes this scaler, not an additive negative DEF; post-scaler final-additions retain the shared attribute ordering.
runtimeMapping.s1: Selected own DEF percent/probabilistic PHYSICAL BlockDamage event10. Selected attack@def is owner-range derived own-token DEF percent. S1 does not require token; selected duration/stat/prob levels are preserved.
runtimeMapping.s2: Native onlyAvailableWhenTokenValid1, selected owner ASPD, global source token ATK percent and mode1. MultiMelee selector caps default-priority WALK victims to max(1,current block capacity), not currently blocked only. .1 delayed-first validity checker ends binding and clears/stops SP if actual token disappears.
runtimeMapping.s3: Native onlyAvailableWhenTokenValid1, global token DEF percent/mode2. Ratio ATK sampled immediately then every1s using remaining selected duration. Own enemy kill removes no_kill_mark. Derived effect finish while living applies selected max-HP PURE NORMAL/skipModifierEvent damage directly with attack/noSpfalse/applyWaynone and without hpLoss tag. Source forced owner withdrawal removes token without a defeated-state explosion.
runtimeMapping.recharge: Original charge_token[finish] ON_OWNER_FINISH starts source phase respawn clock on removal and restores stock1. Actual owner removal withdraws tokens; a fresh owner born charges stock1.
runtimeMapping.death: E2 selected token talent x-4/ALL motion with value1200/stun3, pot5 value1400/stun3.5. Only defeated token emits, retreat/owner-forced-withdrawal does not. Original stationary projectile retained independently; guaranteed alwaysReachInTheEnd with lifetime1 is represented by one expiry pulse, excluding hidden/free/Sleep/invisible recipients while permitting distinct camouflage.

verificationLimits: No native C# executable dispatcher or frame parity is claimed. Original numeric selectors, callback/event ordering and attribute aggregation are retained rather than reverse engineered from table descriptions.

Heal postFilter64 priority and HEAL-purpose injured selection are bounded by the original description. Native tie ordering/full-HP acceptance and heal projectile target-loss dispatch are not recovered; ordinary legal injured-recipient priority and deployment-locked impact are explicit.

S1 BuffAura range and S2/S3 TokenBuffAura host semantics are distinguished by original script/fields and description; native category3/sameHost numeric dispatcher is unrecovered. Only actual owned Mon3tr receives token effects.

Native RemainingRatioToAttributeModifier reads a derived lifetime; selected duration is mapped to immediate then1s remaining-ratio ATK percent. Exact first-trigger/expiry order and foreign percentage aggregation remain bounded.

PURE skipModifierEvent uses existing direct HP application, so the engine retains shared fatal/undeadable safeguards. Native isUndeadable:false versus recipient immunity/floor ordering is unrecovered and is not presented as immunity bypass proof.

The stationary death projectile has no Movement and guaranteed end reach at lifetime1; native initial-reached behavior is unrecovered. End1s pulse is the explicit bounded clock, not a claim that the native visual/explosion necessarily waits1s.

Owner withdrawal suppresses token S3 removal penalty/explosion before forced non-dead-state withdrawal. Exact derived-buff finish versus owner-finish ordering is unrecovered, while genuine defeated and manual-retreat paths remain separate.

Token card recharge/born order and prior remaining redeploy timer under artificially accelerated owner redeploy are unexecuted native lifecycle; fresh owner born uses current stock1 and source next-token clock.
Unity particles/audio effects are not fabricated. Original token/owner attack clips and tracked generic healing projectile are used; original skill/death effect particle graphs remain unsupported.
